moment.text: With the arrival of the print, ornament prints became an important part of the output of printmakers, especially in Germany, and played a vital role in the rapid diffusion of new Renaissance styles to makers of all sorts of object.

matters.text: The Little Masters also engraved ornamental motifs for craftsmen to adapt in decorative works … Indeed, they might have planned their whole production to furnish ideas for other artists, who copied their diminutive engravings wholesale, especially in the enamel workshops at Limoges.

source.author: A. Hyatt Mayor

matters.text: Their prints were very widely disseminated, and  both drawn copies and examples of the originals have been found in albums from Mughal India, and their figurative compositions were copied in Limoges enamel and various other decorative media, from bronze plaques to stoneware pottery.
